# Measuring GEO and AI Visibility in 2026: A Comparative Analysis of Commercial Metrics and Academic Constructs  

The rapid rise of AI answer engines has forced marketers, analysts, and researchers to rethink how they measure visibility, authority, and influence in search-like environments. Across 2025–2026, a dense ecosystem of *Generative Engine Optimization* (GEO) and *Answer Engine Optimization* (AEO) tools has emerged, each proposing its own vocabulary and key performance indicators for tracking how brands and products appear in AI-generated answers on platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Amazon Rufus, and emerging AI shopping surfaces.[1][4][6][9][11][35][38][39] This report synthesizes the measurement frameworks of ten leading tools—Profound, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Peec AI, AthenaHQ, Goodie, Otterly, Scrunch AI, Evertune, Semrush’s AI Visibility Toolkit, and HubSpot AEO / AEO Grader—and places their metrics in a shared conceptual and methodological frame. It catalogues the exact KPI names those platforms publish, describes their definitions and formulas where disclosed, clarifies the units used, and, where possible, documents emerging industry benchmarks or ranges. At the same time, it connects these commercial practices to relevant academic work on citation analysis, computational text analysis, and ranking metrics, and it evaluates the status of several named constructs—ELCA, AIGVR, AECR, CTAM, and RTAS—marking clearly where primary sources exist and where they do not.[22][24][25][26]

The analysis shows that beneath a diverse surface vocabulary, GEO tools converge on a small set of conceptual clusters: presence or **visibility** (how often a brand is mentioned), **citation** or source usage (how often its domain is referenced), **position or ranking inside the answer** (where in the response it appears relative to competitors), **sentiment or narrative quality** (how it is described), **recommendation strength** (whether it is actively endorsed as a top option), and **business impact** (AI referral traffic, conversions, and revenue).[1][
